audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer has Warwick winning levels 1-2 under the non-champion token 'WW' at 3/10 and 3.5/10, and both layers mark levels 3, 4-5 and First item as 'Skill' while marking Level 6 as Garen. The packet chart is Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Warwick, Garen, Garen.
audit.why: whys[0] and whys[1] say Garen out-trades a low-sustain Warwick at 1-2; whys[2] and whys[3] say the all-in still out-damages his sustain at 3-4; whys[4] says his heal out-trades you 'briefly' at 5; whys[5] and whys[6] hand the lane back to Garen. Packet and prose agree; only the tokens disagree, and the full layer's level 1-2 rating is inverted outright.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 2, 3, 4-5 -> Garen 6/10; Level 6 -> Warwick 4/10 (his heal spike); First item and 2+ items -> Garen 6/10. The 'WW' token is replaced with 'Warwick' by the flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] says his Q heal 'scales with his AD'.
audit.why: Riot's Jaws of the Beast text: it deals damage based on the target's maximum health and heals for damage dealt. That is percent-max-health damage — it scales with YOUR health bar, not his AD, which is exactly why stacking armour or raw HP reads the trade wrong and why Grievous Wounds is the real answer.
audit.corrected: State the max-health scaling and the heal-for-damage-dealt, and point at Grievous Wounds instead of resistances.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] gives Infinite Duress as 90s and describes it only as 'his all-in lock'. The tldr and focus call his passive a 'low-health healing aura'.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is 110/90/70 — 110s at rank 1 — suppresses for 1.5 seconds, and carries the channel flag: it is interruptible, so hard CC breaks him off it. Eternal Hunger is not an aura: his basic attacks deal bonus magic damage, and below 50% health he heals that amount, tripled below 25%. That threshold is the actual reason 'don't fight him at low HP' is true.
audit.corrected: Quote 110s rank 1, the 1.5s suppress, and that the channel can be broken by CC; describe Eternal Hunger by its real 50%/25% thresholds.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags 'Land Infinite Duress' in wants.foe[1]. False positive — Infinite Duress is Warwick's real R per the kit file.

edits.before: : Warwick changes the lane by forcing Garen to respect Warwick Primal Howl and low-health healing aura.
edits.after: Warwick's Eternal Hunger heals him below 50% health and triples it below 25% — anti-heal before you commit.

edits.before: Track Warwick’s Infinite Duress (90s): His all-in lock. Dodge it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is 110s at rank 1 and a 1.5s suppress. It is a channel — CC breaks it.

edits.before: Extend into his heal. Get caught by his R. Fight at low HP early. Save the R for moments with names on them.
edits.after: Extend into his heal. Get caught by his R. Fight him below 50% — that is when Eternal Hunger turns back on you.

edits.before: Around 5 Warwick's Q heal scales with his AD and Jaws of the Beast sustains him through your poke, letting him trade back where he could not earlier.
edits.after: Around 5 Jaws of the Beast bites for a share of your max health and heals him for the damage dealt, so armour does not fix the trade — buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a hard suppress; if he lands it you are locked while he heals, but your Q silence timed on his approach can pre-empt the ult engage.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s on a 110s rank-1 cooldown, and it is a channel — hard CC from you or your jungler breaks him off it mid-ult.
